name: Jelling Mounds, Runic Stones and Church
description: In the small town of Jelling in Jutland, Denmark, two huge grassy burial mounds stand beside a modest church and a pair of carved runestones from the 10th century. King Gorm the Old raised the smaller stone for his wife Thyra. His son Harald Bluetooth raised the larger one, which boasts of his conquests and of making the Danes Christian.
